rule: Every Production incident that was a NEW failure mode gets a named deterministic scenario in this catalog before we call the incident closed. That is how the simulator grows. Simulator passed still only means known scenarios did not regress — never that nothing is wrong.
maintain: Add a named scenario the same day a NEW Production failure mode is found. Do not mark the incident closed until the scenario id exists in the battery. Update this list when a deploy or HITL shows a new class.
